documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year. Gross margins expanded by 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6%, while EBITDA margin stood at 7.9%. For H1 FY27, operating cash flow turned positive at INR 136 crores compared to an outflow of INR 101 crores in H1 last year. The company saw strong momentum in its exports business, reaching INR 435 crores in Q2 FY27, while advance gold volume contribution reached 16%. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹4,403.5 crore for H1 FY27, representing a 68.3% Y-o-Y growth.

guidance.claim: Management stated that its past margin percentage guidance remains on track despite regulatory restrictions on providing forward guidance.
guidance.quote: Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance, but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold surpassed its original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 crore a year early.
guidance.quote: Original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr surpassed a year early

guidance.claim: Following its FY24 preferential allotment, Sky Gold had guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: Sky Gold targets FY27 revenue of INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue between INR 18,000 crores and INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a long-term PAT margin target of 5.25%.
guidance.quote: So, yes, from the overall guidance to the Street, 5.25% of the PAT margin still holds, while we plan and aimed at how we can reach the magical number of INR1,000 crores of PAT going forward.

guidance.claim: The company targets an operating cash flow to PAT conversion rate of close to 20%.
guidance.quote: But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed a continuous shift in product demand from 22-karat jewelry to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Uncut diamond jewelry is witnessing strong market demand and commands higher margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Uncut diamonds, uncut diamond jewelry is in strong demand and carries high margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold's merchandising team onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains.
demand_outlook.quote: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer.

demand_outlook.claim: Organised manufacturers continue to see an increasing presence in the Indian jewellery industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian jewellery industry continues to witness an increasing presence of organised manufacturers within the overall market, creating a favourable backdrop for companies with established capabilities, scale, and customer relationships.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold has built a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower Karatage products now represent nearly 14% of volume due to shifting customer preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation. They now contribute close to 14% of volume and has gross margin contribution of close to 1.4% to 1.5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the organized sector share in the market to reach 75% by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: So as per exports, we are expecting by 2030, 75% market will be organized and 25% will be unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold commenced operations at its international office in Dubai in September 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: In September 2025, we started operations of our international office in Dubai, led by Mr. Hiralal, who brings 30 plus years of experience in Dubai and GCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Promoters will purchase the land themselves if no third-party commitment is finalized within 20 to 30 days.
capex_expansion.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold opened a Dubai office as part of its international expansion.
Sky Gold estimates future post-2028 capacity expansion capex between INR 80 crores and INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Developing a new facility to expand capacity from 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons will take 120 days.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it will take 120 days. We made this facility in 90 days where we are here now, and it will take 120 days to develop the factory to go to 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons and 100% it will take around INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex when we will be at a PAT of, I think, INR600 crores, whatever the number going to come -and will approximately 15% or 20% of the PAT.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA came in at INR 189.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 7.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: The company reduced its gold loss during manufacturing from 1.5% to 0.5%.
margins_costs.quote: We have also cut gold loss from 1.5% to 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: An increase in the value-added share of business served as the main driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementing ERP for monitoring operational KPIs resulted in a reduction of gold loss.
margins_costs.quote: Implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin reached 9.3% in Q1 FY27, up 27 basis points from Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached INR 157 crores, translating to an EBITDA margin of 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Sky Gold maintains gross margin guidance in the range of 8.5% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: The guidance of 8.5% to 9% gross margin we are giving, because, in the journey of business, you can see if 22 karat is somebody is taking volume, we have to pass on some 0.25% to 0.5% discount also to the customers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved exports of INR 435 crores in Q2 FY27 alone.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2 FY27, we have reached exports of INR435 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Advance gold contributed 16% to total business in Q2 FY27, exceeding the target of 15%.
orders_capacity.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold is operating at approximately 60% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a total production capacity of 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Advance Gold model sales reached 17% of overall sales in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: I am pleased to share that we have achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, significantly ahead of our expectation of 15% of the Advance Gold model for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt decreased to INR 531 crores at the end of September from INR 550 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt was INR531 crores at September end, and versus INR550 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow for H1 FY27 came in at INR 136 crores compared to an outflow of INR 101 crores in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Most importantly, we generated INR136 crores of operating cash flow in H1, against an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will draw no salaries starting from FY27 and will receive payouts solely through dividends from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold previously indicated expansion would be funded via internal cash generation.
capital_allocation.quote: Sky Gold had previously indicated that expansion would be supported through internal cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening remain Sky Gold's top capital allocation priority before paying dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening. Dividend distribution will follow only after these objectives have been appropriately addressed.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model beginning FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 540 crores for the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold generated approximately INR 30 crores in operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Reported PAT in Q2 FY27 was impacted by an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores related to a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sky Gold did not achieve 100% GML conversion by December FY25.
risks_headwinds.quote: 100% conversion by Dec FY25 not achieved.

risks_headwinds.claim: The completion timeline for the land sale has been extended beyond August 2026.
Sky Gold reported a fraudulent incident involving INR 10.7 crores, of which INR 3.5 crores has been recovered.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility has created margin pressures across retailers and manufacturers in the jewelry sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will acquire the land if an independent third-party commitment is not secured within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will draw no salaries starting from FY27, with payouts sourced entirely from operating cash flow dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aims to achieve revenue of INR 8,100 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching revenue of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model starting FY27, receiving payouts only from operating cash flow dividends.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aims to become a net debt-free company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
